heath.name: Heath
heath.role: Mountain guide keeping a shelter open while Ellis is missing

ff.heath.first.text: Looking for Ellis? Follow his scratched arrows uphill. The Legion is searching for him too.

choices.text: I came to find him. What do I need?

effects.title: Shelter before the storm
effects.text: The heater coil has fallen loose beside the frozen crossing. Fit it into the winch by Heath’s shelter. The western lift-house ridge is an optional sheltered route.

choices.text: Skip the weather report. Where is he?

effects.title: A trail in the snow
effects.text: Ellis scratched arrows toward Heath’s shelter above the switchbacks. The Legion is searching this mountain too.

effects.title: The heater coil
effects.text: The heater coil fell loose from the crossing winch. Put it back in the empty socket beside Heath’s shelter.

effects.title: The buried cave
effects.text: The cave mouth is buried beneath an unstable snow cornice. Follow the broken stone shelves above the entrance and release the brass anchor. The snow will slide away below you.

effects.title: Something under the snow
effects.text: The notebook says: “Our chest is under the rig’s snow cover. Reach the anchor above camp and let the cover fall.” The broken ledges climb toward it.

effects.title: The explorer’s keepsakes
effects.text: The exposed chest held a winter cloak. Collect the Rift Shard beside it yourself. Reach Deep Ice Caves to keep both discoveries.
